entities.name: Noranda-Zang
entities.description: A human thaumaturge who ruled Everlorne and was possibly a planeswalker; he can reconstitute in a new body.

entities.name: Thane Du-Moriss IV
entities.description: A minor wizard who stabbed Zang in the War of Thanopolis and ruled Kieve.

entities.name: Celia
entities.description: Zang's wife, who died giving birth.

entities.name: Bayende
entities.description: Thane's pregnant wife, killed by Zang.

entities.name: Gloom
entities.description: Zang's invisible companion who suggested killing Bayende.

entities.name: Kieve
entities.description: Land ruled by Thane, a haven of peace and plenty.

entities.name: War of Thanopolis
entities.description: War in which Thane defeated Zang.

events.summary: In the War of Thanopolis, Thane stabs Zang in the heart; Zang, having prepared, takes a new body.
events.quote: Zang was defeated by Thane Du-Moriss IV , who stabbed him in the heart

events.summary: After ten years, Zang finds Kieve and summons the shade Caskor, who confirms a wizard rules there.
events.quote: Eventually, he found Kieve and summoned the frozen shade Caskor

events.summary: Prompted by Gloom, Zang kills Thane's pregnant wife Bayende.
After seventeen years Thane finds Everlorne and kills Zang's son.
events.quote: He eventually found Everlorne and killed Zang's son
